changelog.title: OpenMemo 1.8.0
changelog.description:
## [1.8.0] - 2026-05-18

### Added
- Design system rebuild: token-driven CSS, new fonts, full icon set, rebuilt all screens
- Collections page with stacked cards, memo counts, recent titles, edit + drag-to-reorder
- New-memo glass panel with animated tabs (Link/Note/Media/Voice)
- Live Appearance panel: theme, accents, card style, layout, background with fade slider
- Sort dropdown (Recent/Oldest/Title/Custom); command search overlay (⌘K)
- Fullscreen distraction-free writer; storage stats with disk usage breakdown
- Maintenance endpoints (Clear cache, Reset workspace); browser extension card
- First-run onboarding tour; Ask memo chat history with session list
- Local thumbnail cache; dominant-color card backdrops; changelog modal with version check

### Changed
- Memo detail stays routed; new Boxed/Full layout toggle
- Settings redesigned with bento grid masonry; Creator card replaces Identity
- Density locked to roomy; text color reserved for content

### Fixed
- Background image capped 5MB, canvas downscaled before storage
- Collection picker now flyout instead of cropped dropdown
- Masonry columns tightened for better memo card sizing
